name: harbor-mate
description: Unattended runtime for VS Code custom agents on Copilot models: schedules with zero-token wake checks, handoffs, ask/approve gates that resume, policy and audit.

commands.title: Set Secret (env var for skill scripts)

harborMate.modelFamily.description: Default Copilot model family for agents without a 'model' field. Empty = first available.

harborMate.maxSteps.description: Default max model turns per work item.

harborMate.maxMinutes.description: Wall-clock cap for one run, in minutes. The run ends as stalled when it is exceeded.

harborMate.workers.description: How many work items run at the same time. With more than one, one slot is kept free for urgent items. 1 = one at a time.

harborMate.policyFile.description: Default policy for agents without their own 'policy' field.

harborMate.notifyCommand.description: Command run whenever the team needs you (question, approval, blocked, error). Receives the event as JSON in LOOP_EVENT, plus LOOP_EVENT_KIND and LOOP_EVENT_TITLE; secrets are injected. Typically a notify skill script, e.g. "python3 .github/skills/notify-wecom/scripts/send.py". User settings only, so a repository cannot set it.

harborMate.retention.doneDays.description: Days to keep finished work items. Items that ended blocked, error, max_steps or stalled are never removed automatically.

harborMate.retention.runsDays.description: Days to keep run logs (audit). Logs of unfinished or failed work are kept.

harborMate.retention.gateDays.description: Days to keep answered, rejected or executed questions and approvals. Pending ones are never removed.

harborMate.retention.taskDays.description: Days to keep done or dropped tasks. Open tasks are never removed.

harborMate.notifyWebhook.markdownDescription: Post a message here when an agent needs you (a question, an approval, a blocked or failed run). Paste an incoming-webhook URL from Slack, Microsoft Teams or Discord; any other https URL receives the event as JSON. Set it in your user settings, not in a workspace.

harborMate.triggerPort.markdownDescription: Listen for webhooks on this port, on 127.0.0.1 only, so goals with `on: webhook:<name>` can be woken by `POST /hook/<name>` with a bearer token (command: Copy Webhook Example). 0 turns it off. Set it in your user settings.

harborMate.extraPath.markdownDescription: Folders put in front of PATH for every command an agent or probe runs. Use it when a CLI (for example `harbor`) works in your terminal but VS Code cannot find it. Set it in your user settings.

chatParticipants.name: mate
chatParticipants.description: Talk to your agents: see what they are doing, give tasks, change schedules, leave standing notes

commands.name: status
commands.description: Team, schedules and what needs you

commands.name: pending
commands.description: Questions and approvals waiting for you

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that your agents can run, and run their probes once

commands.name: health
commands.description: How each agent has been doing, and what to improve

commands.name: improve
commands.description: Review an agent and propose the smallest fixes

scripts.package: rm -rf out && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=out/extension.js && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.test: tsc -p ./ && node test/e2e.js && node test/console-dom.js && node test/loop-memory.js && node test/harbor-team.js && node test/maintenance.js && node test/doctor.js && node test/triggers.js && node test/console-ui.js
